title: match.assign (platform → server, reliable)
description: Assign a match (FLEET.md §7.1). Envelope `epoch` = payload `epoch`. Answered by exactly one cmd.result (`ref` = this id): ok, or rejected with invalid_config / busy / stale_epoch; with `resume` also checksum (inline backup or backup_ref sha256), no_backup (no such local file) and unsupported (multi-part backup). A replay of the active match_id + epoch is acked ok without effect. A resume of the match this server has loaded (running, or recovered after a crash) reloads it; it is not busy.

config_rev.description: the platform's config_rev for this config (default 1); match.update CAS base
